about: The Vampire Rounds adventure in VS's Adventures menu. It takes VS's unused AdventureType ADV_LIB_001 and StageSetType STAGE_DATA_ADV_BMN002 slots, so no adventure of the game (or its DLC) is replaced, and has its own progress key (no Steam achievement is tied to it).

columns.id: row id (the VS AdventureType slot it takes)
columns.name: title in the Adventures menu
columns.progressKey: its save key (unique: no VS achievement CompleteAdv_<key> exists)
columns.startingCharacter: characters row unlocked from the start
columns.startingCoins: gold at the start of the adventure
columns.completionCoins: gold when the adventure is completed

rows.name: Vampire Rounds
rows.description: ROUNDS's Orange Guy and Blue Guy fight Vampire Survivors's night with ROUNDS's gun and ROUNDS cards, through its five main stages.
